newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: RESEARCH ALERT - CSFB keeps Novartis as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - CSFB keeps Novartis as buy.

text.p: Credit Suisse First Boston equity research maintained a "buy" recommendation for Novartis AG ahead of first-half sales figures expected on July 24.
Novartis was expected to report sales growth of 21.9 percent in Swiss francs and 7.6 percent in local currencies in the first six months, CSFB analysts wrote in an update.
In local currency terms, the report said healthcare sales should grow 10.5 percent, agribusiness sales by 4.0 percent or better and nutrition sales also by 4.0 percent.
"In addition, we remind investors of the fundamental reasons for owning Novartis -- the potent combination of cost-cutting synergies, new product launches and value-focused management," CSFB wrote.
